title: Improve performance for list.insert() and del list[i] in free-threaded builds
author: hetaozdh
body_preview: ### Feature or enhancement  `ins1()`(used by `list.insert()`) and `list_ass_item_lock_held()` shift the list with one atomic release store per element in free-threaded builds.
